transformation_pipeline: Step 1: Domain Definition — 15 canonical research domains defined in backend/evaluation/benchmark_dataset/dataset_schema.py
Step 2: Fact-Check Query & Response Alignment — Balanced pairs of factual (0) and hallucinated (1) claim statements curated per domain
Step 3: Multi-Domain Deterministic Expansion — 50 claims generated per domain with cyclic difficulty assignment (easy, medium, hard) via seed 42
Step 4: Schema Normalization — Encoded into standardized BenchmarkExample data structure (id, question, response, ground_truth, domain, difficulty, claims, evidence_passages)
Step 5: Deduplication Audit — Verified 0 duplicate IDs and 0 duplicate (question, response) tuples
Step 6: Integrity Freeze — Persisted to backend/evaluation/results/benchmark_dataset.jsonl and cryptographic SHA-256 registered
